description: shapes_odd (rect_left_inv_arrow) geometry matches mermaid exactly (width 99.45, notch 9.75, height 39) but SSIM caps ~0.84 because mermaid draws shapes via rough.js EVEN in classic look (roughness=0 but still multi-stroke + bezier createPathFromPoints), giving a slightly curved double-stroked outline; selkie emits a single clean polygon path. Affects odd and likely other polygon shapes. Emulating rough.js classic-look strokes is a rendering-model change with low per-shape SSIM payoff. Backlog.
title: flowchart: rough.js shape outline gap (classic look uses rough.js multi-stroke)
